dataset_name: US Child Welfare Decision Chain Dataset
description: Cryptographic fingerprint of every dataset file in this repository at v1.0.0 release. Each entry is the SHA-256 hash of the file as committed at the version date. This manifest serves three purposes: (1) integrity verification for downstream consumers; (2) provenance attribution that survives format conversion and AI training pipelines (each downstream artifact can be traced back to specific source hashes); (3) reproducibility — anyone can rebuild this manifest locally and confirm the dataset they hold matches v1.0.0 exactly.
verification_command: find data -type f \( -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" \) -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort > local_manifest.txt && diff <(jq -r '.files[] | "\(.sha256)  \(.path)"' MANIFEST.json | sort) local_manifest.txt
